Beginner.learningGoal: Model data with records: value equality, with-expressions and positional syntax.
gotchas: Records compare by value, classes by reference
with creates a shallow copy: a List inside is shared
Positional records expose public init properties
goodSolutionShows: Records for data, classes for behaviour-heavy objects
Readable ToString through the record's default
shapeHints: a push notification draft that is edited step by step

Intermediate.learningGoal: Design immutable domain types with validation and safe collection members.
gotchas: Validation in a positional record needs an explicit constructor or property initialiser
Exposing List<T> from an immutable type lets callers mutate it
Equality of records holding arrays compares references
goodSolutionShows: Validation that can't be bypassed by with
IReadOnlyList or ImmutableArray for collection members
shapeHints: an immutable feed post with tags

Advanced.learningGoal: Use record structs, readonly structs and immutable collections with performance in mind.
gotchas: Defensive copies when calling non-readonly members on readonly struct fields
record struct is mutable unless declared readonly record struct
ImmutableList is slower for indexing than ImmutableArray
goodSolutionShows: readonly record struct for small value types
The right immutable collection for the access pattern
shapeHints: an immutable settings snapshot shared across threads
